```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
```


# Sheet 1: GDP

```{r}
sheet_path <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sjlFBN7OtLp40IEj3qQWhFbkEeAkPOWhvoLd-25nOEc/"
gdp_bd <- read_sheet(ss=sheet_path, sheet = "GDP",
                     skip = 29,col_names = c("year","gdp16","gnp","gdp"))

```

```{r}
library(tsibble)
gdp_ts <- tsibble(gdp_bd,index = year)
gdp_ts
```



```{r}
glimpse(gdp_ts)
```

```{r}
gdp_ts %>% 
  mutate(gdp_gr = (gdp / lag(gdp) - 1))
```
# Sheet 2: Export and Import 

```{r}
exim_bd <- read_sheet(ss=sheet_path, sheet = "EXIM",
                     skip = 29, col_names =       c("month","ex_index","imp_index","export","import")) |> 
      mutate(month=yearmonth(month))
exim_bd
```

```{r}
exim_bd_ts <- tsibble(exim_bd,index = month)
exim_bd_ts
```

```{r}
exim_bd_fis <- exim_bd_ts |> 
  mutate(cal_year=year(month),
         mon_num=month(month),
         fis_year=ifelse(mon_num >7,cal_year+1,cal_year)
         )
glimpse(exim_bd_fis)
```


```{r}
exim_bd_sum <- exim_bd_fis |> 
  index_by(fis_year) |> 
  summarise(exp_index_mean=mean(ex_index,na.rm=T),
            imp_index_mean=mean(imp_index,na.rm=T),
            exp_total=sum(export,na.rm=T),
            imp_total=sum(import,na.rm=T)
            )
glimpse(exim_bd_sum)
```


```{r}
exim_bd_sum
```

# Sheet 3: Other indicators

```{r}
var_names <- c("month","elec_sales","elec_gen","quantum_manu","dom_credit",
                         "revenue_grants","revenue_tax")
other_ind <- read_sheet(ss=sheet_path, sheet = "Dom Par",skip = 28) |> 
    select(1:7) |> 
  set_names(var_names) |> 
  mutate(month=yearmonth(month)) |> 
    drop_na(month) |> 
    filter(!if_all(-month, is.na))
    #janitor::remove_empty()
           
glimpse(other_ind)
```

```{r}
skimr::skim(other_ind)
```



```{r}
other_ind_ts <- tsibble(other_ind,index = month)
other_ind_ts
```

```{r}
other_ind_fis <- other_ind_ts |> 
  mutate(cal_year=year(month),
         mon_num=month(month),
         fis_year=ifelse(mon_num >7,cal_year+1,cal_year)
         #fis_year=as.character(fis_year)
         )
glimpse(other_ind_fis)
```

```{r}
other_ind_fis2 <- other_ind_fis |> 
                         select(-c(mon_num,cal_year)) |> 
                         relocate(fis_year)
glimpse(other_ind_fis2)
```




```{r}
other_ind_sum <- other_ind_fis2 |> 
  index_by(fis_year) |> 
  summarize(across(c(elec_sales,elec_gen,quantum_manu,dom_credit,revenue_grants,revenue_tax), 
                   ~mean(.x,na.rm=T) ))
glimpse(other_ind_sum)
```


```{r}
other_ind_sum
```


# Merging

```{r}
gdp_est_whole <- gdp_ts |> 
  inner_join(exim_bd_sum,by=c("year"="fis_year")) |> 
  inner_join(other_ind_sum,by=c("year"="fis_year"))
glimpse(gdp_est_whole)
```

## Remove year 25

```{r}
gdp_est_whole <-  gdp_est_whole |> 
                       mutate(exp_real=round(exp_total/exp_index_mean,1)) |> 
                       rename(exp_usd=exp_total) |> 
                       filter(!year == 2025) |> 
                       select(year,exp_real,exp_usd,
                              elec_gen,dom_credit,
                              revenue_tax,gdp)
```

## Growth variables

```{r}
gdp_est_gr <- gdp_est_whole |> 
                   arrange(year) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      c(gdp, exp_real,exp_usd,dom_credit,elec_gen,revenue_tax),
      ~ 100 * (log(.) - log(lag(.))),
      .names = "{.col}_gr"),
    period = case_when(
    year >= 2004 & year <= 2015 ~ "2004-2015",
    year >= 2016 & year <= 2025 ~ "2016-2024",
    .default =  NA_character_)
  ) |> 
  arrange(year)
```


```{r}
save(gdp_est_gr, file = "./Data/gdp_est_gr.rda")
```



## Convert to long 

```{r}
gdp_est_long <- gdp_est_whole |> 
  pivot_longer(cols=-year,names_to = "indicators") |> 
  arrange(indicators,year)
glimpse(gdp_est_long)
```

## Calculate CGAR

```{r}
cagr_data <- gdp_est_long |> 
              as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(period = case_when(
    year >= 2004 & year <= 2015 ~ "2004-2015",
    year >= 2016 & year <= 2025 ~ "2016-2024",
    .default =  NA_character_
  )) %>%
  group_by(indicators, period) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  # Calculate CAGR: (End Value / Start Value)^(1 / Years) - 1
  summarise(
    start_val = first(value),
    end_val = last(value),
    n_years = n() - 1,
    cagr = ((end_val / start_val)^(1 / n_years) - 1) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
glimpse(cagr_data)
```

```{r}
cagr_data
```



```{r}

gdp_est_cagr <- cagr_data |>
                    group_by(indicators) |> 
                    filter(all(is.finite(cagr)))

reorder_ind_names <- c("exp_real","exp_usd",
                       "dom_credit", "elec_gen",
                        "revenue_tax","gdp")

# Convert Indicator to a factor to control the order on the x-axis
# We put GDP last so it matches the image

gdp_est_cagr$indicators <- factor(gdp_est_cagr$indicators, 
                              levels = reorder_ind_names)

#gdp_est_cagr <- gdp_est_cagr |> 
 #                   mutate(indicators=fct_relevel(indicators,reorder_ind_names))

```


```{r}
save(gdp_est_cagr,file = "./Data/gdp_est_cagr.rda")
```
